continuation.summary: The ATS triage classifier currently treats text, email, tel, and url controls as interchangeable for every recognized contact field. Consequently, a verified full_name mapped to an email input, or a verified email mapped to a telephone input, can incorrectly receive verified_candidate. The existing 124 passing tests do not exercise these type-to-contact mismatches. The required autonomous regression file is missing.: Reject mismatched native contact control types with human_review and reason mismatched_contact_control. Preserve supported native mappings and generic text contact controls. Preserve ambiguity, unknown-question, unsupported-control, and unverified-fact safeguards. Create tests/test_ats_question_triage_autonomous.py with public parameterized regressions. Keep immutable tests byte-identical. All ten mandatory test cases must pass independently in the isolated worker before any commit. No network access, private data, submissions, deployment, publication, or merges.
